name: yzmir-structure-synthesis
description: Generative models whose outputs are graphs: typed DAG grammars with node/edge/cost ceilings, deterministic and latent-conditioned generation, best-of-K pools, mutation and recombination over lineages, canonicalisation to normal forms, equivalence detection, and semantic hashing. General to neural architecture search, program synthesis over typed IRs, and molecule/circuit generation. Keeps the generator honest by separating generation from structural verification from utility judgement - a generator that filters its own pool by predicted utility is grading its own examination. Ships a router + 13 specialist sheets, 3 commands (/design-graph-grammar, /scaffold-structure-generator, /audit-canonicalisation), and 2 SME-protocol-conformant agents (structure-synthesis-architect, synthesis-integrity-reviewer).
